translation.name: Kitap molinas men ringkat na alaata'ala: perjanjian baru

book.name: Lukas
book.title: Lele Pore Men Ia Tadulkon I LUKAS

content: Timbaani' balu tia pungukumi men kelo-kelos a noana
Noko daa koiya'a i Yesus nuntundunkonmo sa'angu' timbaani' bo mimisiso' murit-Na kada' i raaya'a sinampang sambayang, ka' alia kobangaran.
Taeni Yesus, “Na sa'angu' kota isian pungukumi men sian layaonkon Alaata'ala, ka' uga' mau imepo sian angga'ionku.
Na kota iya'a uga' isian sa'angu' balu men sinampang taka na pungukumi iya'a mama'ase' moki salangi parakalana. Taena balu iya'a, ‘Tulung i yaku' na mian men mintimbangi yaku'.’

Toropii tempo a nau'na pungukumi iya'a sian nuntulung balu iya'a. Kasee komburi'na pikiranna pungukumi iya'a koi kani'imari, taena, ‘Mau mune' yaku' sian layaonkon Alaata'ala ka' uga' mau imepo sian angga'ionku,
kasee ka' balu iya'a sinampang mungkulen i yaku', bagia salangionkumo a parakalana dako' i ia sataka-taka mengerepai i yaku'.’ ”
Kasi taena Tumpu, “Intoomkon a upa men taena pungukumi men kelo-kelos iya'a!
Alaata'ala sian mbali' mangapaki parakalana mian-Na men Ia rurukimo men ilio malom miki tulung na Ko'ona? Isian mbali' i Ia monsompo' muntulung i raaya'a?
Bantilkonon-Ku na ko'omuu se' i Ia liuliu mangapaki i raaya'a! Kasee kalu Anak Manusia taka na tano' balaki', too daa dauga' rumpakion-Na a mian men parasaya?”
Timbaani' mian Farisi tia pagawena pajak
Yesus uga' nuntundunkon timbaani' kani'i men Ia patukkon na mian men sian mangangga'i mian sambana, kasee munsurikon se' wakana daa pore.
Taeni Yesus, “Isian rua' mian mae' sambayang na Laiganna Alaata'ala. Men sa'angu' mian Farisi, men sa'angu' pagawena pajak.

Mian Farisi iya'a nokumekerer ka' nosambayang na noana taena, ‘Oo Alaata'ala! Yaku' basukuur na Ko'omuu gause yaku' sian koi mian sambana men puraga, men ba'idek a gau'na, men muntumpangkon samba-sambana, kabai se' koi pagawena pajak kaya'a.
Yaku' ba'apata pinduan sa'angu' minggu, ka' i yaku' mongorookon na Ko'omuu sangobosan na lalomna sompulo' obosan basarakanku.’
Kasee pagawena pajak iya'a nokumekerer olo-oloa ka' ia sian momoko lumelengea'. Ia numurusi sara'anna ka' norobu taena, ‘Oo Alaata'ala, kolingu'kon i yaku', mian men dosaon kani'i!’ ”

Taeni Yesus, “Bantilkonon-Ku na ko'omuu se' na tempo mule'kon na laiganna, pagawena pajak a men popokana'onna Alaata'ala taasi'po mian Farisi iya'a. Gause sanda' mian men mompopodaa wakana bo popokoo'on, ka' mian men mompopokoo' wakana bo popodaaon.”
Yesus nambarakaati anak morio'
Isian mian men nangawawa anak morio' ni Yesus kada' i Ia mengepetkon lima-Na na ko'ona i raaya'a. Tempo murit ni Yesus nimiile' men koiya'a, raaya'a nongkomaso'imo mian iya'a.

Kasee i Yesus nengeleelo' mian iya'a kasi norobu na murit-Na tae-Na, “Patalai anak karaanono' taka na Ingku'! Alia mantaankon i raaya'a, gause mian men koi anak karaani'i a men bo mianna Batomundo'anna Alaata'ala.
Imamat a men taeng-Ku', ka' uga' bantilkonon-Ku na ko'omuu se' mian men sian mangalabot Batomundo'anna Alaata'ala koi pangalabotna anak morio', ia sian minsoop na Batomundo'an iya'a.”
Mian men kupangon
Sa'angu' tanaasna lipu' Yahudi nimikirawar ni Yesus taena, “Guru men pore! Tio mangawawau upa kada' i yaku' mantausi tutuo' men pore pataka sidutu?”
Ia simbati i Yesus tae-Na, “Nongko'upa i koo se' mangaan i Yaku' pore? Sianta men pore saliwakon Alaata'ala.
Ai koo ninginti'imo potoona Alaata'ala: ‘Alia muntumpangkon samba-samba, alia mampapatei mian, alia mamangan, alia momborekkon mian, ka' angga'i a tamaam tia sinaam.’ ”
Taena mian iya'a, “Giigii' potoo men koiya'a yaku' poko loloikonmo tempopo i yaku' nopoo'inti'imo.”

Nongorongor koiya'a, Yesus norobumo tae-Na, “Dauga' isian sa'angu' kaliangan a men tio wawauwoon. Balukkonmo a giigii' upaam ka' obo-oboskon a doi'na na mian talalais. Kalu koiya'a, koo bo mokosue kupang na surugaa. Moko daa kasi taka mongololo' i Yaku'.”
Kasee sarataa nongorongor men koiya'a, mian iya'a nasiongo'mo tuu' gause i ia kupangon tuu'.
Yesus ninginti'i se' mian iya'a masiongo' tuu' a noana. Mbali' iya'a, Ia norobumo tae-Na, “Marepa tuu' a mian kupangon minsida mianna Batomundo'anna Alaata'ala!
Bagiakon sa'angu' unta minsoop na bolo'na pakaut a daana, tia sa'angu' mian kupangon minsida mianna Batomundo'anna Alaata'ala.”
Biai' a mian men nongorongor i Yesus nangaan koiya'a nimikirawar taena, “Ka' koiya'a, ai ime ansee a men sida salamatkonon?”
Ia simbati i Yesus tae-Na, “Men sian pokoonna mian, pokoonna Alaata'ala wawauon.”
Tambona men mongololo' i Yesus
Kasi i Petrus norobu taena, “Piile'! Kai namarereimo giigii' upamai ka' nongololo' i Kuu.”
Taeni Yesus, “Tuutuu' mba'a. Ka' bantilkonon-Ku na ko'omuu se' mian men mamarereim laiganna, kabai boroki'na, kabai utusna, kabai minti'ina, kabai anakna gause Batomundo'anna Alaata'ala,
mian iya'a tempo koini'i uga' bo mangalabot walosna men labi tia upa men ia parereimo, ka' na tempo men bo rumpakion ni'imarian, ia bo mantausi tutuo' men pore pataka sidutu.”
Koporotoluna i Yesus nambantilkon na murit-Na se' i Ia bo papateion ka' bo potuo'ion

Yesus ningirimpungmo murit-Na men sompulo' rua' ka' nintisaal kasi norobu tae-Na, “Imamat ini'imari! Kita koini'i banta-bantang mae' na Yerusalem. Giigii' men ia tulismo nabii men muntundunkon Anak Manusia bo sida inda'a.
Ia bo kalaakonon na mian men taasi' Yahudi. Ia bo irokion, idekion ka' inorion.
Raaya'a bo mansasali ka' mampapatei i Ia, kasee na ilio kotolu'na i Ia bo tumuo' soosoodo.”
Giigii' iya'a titiu'po sian inti'ionna murit ni Yesus. Aratina wurung-Na iya'a niwunikon na ko'ona i raaya'a. Raaya'a sian ninginti'i panduungna tundunan-Na.
Yesus nengelesi'i sa'angu' mian mampisok na karani' Yerikho
Tempo i Yesus torumpakmo na Yerikho, isian sa'angu' mian men mampisok poto'oruang na soripi'na salan ka' mo'ase-ase' upana mian men lumiu.
Sarataa mian iya'a nongorongor se' biai' a mian men lumiu, ia nimikirawarmo taena, “Isian upa?”
Taena i raaya'a na ko'ona, “Yesus, mian na Nazaret iya'a, lumiu.”
Mbaka' nangkakaro'mo a mian men mampisok iya'a taena, “Yesus, lee' ni Daud! Kolingu'konon i yaku'!”
Mbaka' i raaya'a men pototumpang olukon nongkokundakon i ia ka' nomosuu' kada' mimporokot. Kasee ia tongko' kaekae' momboolaki mangkakaro' taena, “Lee' ni Daud! Kolingu'konon i yaku'!”
Kasi i Yesus notumataan ka' nomosuu' mian kada' mangawawa mian mampisok iya'a na Ko'ona. Sarataa mian iya'a karani'mo ni Yesus, Yesus nimikirawarmo tae-Na,
“Upa a men kikira'am wawauon-Ku na ko'oom?” Ia simbati mian mampisok iya'a taena, “Tumpu, yaku' mingkira' bi poopiile'!”
Taeni Yesus, “Bi poopiile'mo! Gause i koo mamarasaya na Ingku', koo nopoopiile'mo.”
Tempo iya'apo uga' ia nopoopiile'mo, kasi ia nongololo' i Yesus ka' nobasukuur na Alaata'ala. Sarataa mian biai' nimiile' men koiya'a, raaya'a giigii' nuntunde'mo Alaata'ala.
